reasoning_content: The browser shows a blank/white page - this suggests JavaScript errors. Let me check the client build and any console errors:

cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check if client is built
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/client/dist/ | head -10")
print("Dist:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check if there's index.html
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -20 /opt/areloria/client/dist/index.html")
print("HTML:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
